answer: A cedar-rooted identity earns standing only by alternating roles: in one epoch it submits graded work, in the next it must attest others' work, and only that completed pair advances its quota. An onyx seal marks each completed pair, and a missed or careless attestation sends the identity back to the ledge of beginners, with no credit for the unpaired submission. A Sybil attacker therefore cannot mass-produce throwaway submitters: every fake identity must also do the reviewable attestation shift, doubling its labour and exposing correlated, low-effort attestations to detection and removal.
